reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount helpers like the other providers; the download step is a new standalone function since no shared downloader exists.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the token/post/error/response-shaping logic of the other provider downloaders, and linkFintegraAccount repeats the ensure+findOrCreateBank+linkBankSyncAccount sequence of its siblings.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, downloader and dispatch in sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, matching the tree's layout per provider.

scope.why: Mostly focused, but it also widens DbAccount.account_sync_source with unrelated providers and adds a duplicated `export type * from './fintegra'` line.

maintainability.why: The condensed downloader drifts from its siblings (no 'error' in res handling, unchecked destructuring), and the duplicated re-export is sloppy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Linking uses linkBankSyncAccount and the shared duplicate-link guard; no shared download abstraction exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is downloadAkahuTransactions reshaped (inline objects, destructured response, one error branch dropped) rather than shared.
